title: Implement original crayon design system and homepage responsive layout

notes: Added the exact ordered 32-game catalog, responsive searchable/filterable browse UI, hash-based home/catalog/detail navigation, procedural local artwork, and honest Coming soon/disabled-start states for every unvalidated game. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (5 passing), and build on 2026-11-14.

title: Camera permissions, device selection, mirrored preview, lifecycle and error states
notes: Added an isolated browser-native CameraSource and responsive setup flow with interaction-gated permission, device selection/restart, mirrored preview, track-end disconnect recovery, actionable permission/missing/busy/unsupported errors, simulation mode, and stream cleanup on navigation. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (10 passing), and build on 2026-11-14. Physical webcam behavior remains unverified and requires hardware validation.

title: Player count 1–4; separate configurable camera zones and viewport mapping with coordinate tests
notes: Added 1–4 player selection, independently configurable normalized camera zones, separate specified game viewport layouts, consistent mirrored camera-to-player coordinate mapping, accessible zone overlays/controls, and synthetic coordinate/UI tests. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (15 passing), and build on 2026-11-14. Physical multi-person framing and webcam behavior remain unverified and require hardware validation.

title: Frame-differencing motion input, synthetic simulator, mask debug overlay and calibration UI
notes: Implemented low-resolution frame differencing with denoising, temporal smoothing, sensitivity/noise calibration, per-zone normalized MOTION_HIT events and debounce; added a deterministic synthetic simulator, live player motion meters, optional mask/zone/threshold/FPS/hit debug overlay, and calibration controls. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (19 passing), and build on 2026-11-14. Physical webcam motion feel, lighting/noise behavior, latency, and browser compatibility remain unverified and require hardware validation.

title: Game session timing, score isolation, state machine and tests
notes: Added a deterministic shared GameSession state machine with configurable countdown/round timing, pause/resume, results/replay transitions, and isolated 1–4 player scores. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (24 passing), and build on 2026-11-14.

title: Implement Bubble Battle fully for one player via generic motion input with tests
notes: Implemented a complete one-player Bubble Battle round consuming generic normalized MOTION_HIT events, with countdown/round/results/replay, deterministic floating targets, bubble scoring, bomb penalties, pointer fallback, camera/demo setup integration, and honest one-player catalog availability. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (7 files, 31 tests passed), and build on 2026-11-14. Physical webcam motion feel remains unverified and requires hardware validation.

title: Enable tested two-player Bubble Battle independent viewports, score, results/replay
notes: Enabled validated one- and two-player Bubble Battle with player-scoped targets and generic motion events, independent side-by-side viewports, isolated scores/penalties/feedback, shared timing, competitive winner/tie results, and replay reset. title: Implement browser end-to-end tests with mocked media streams and deterministic motion fixtures
notes: Added and executed a Playwright browser suite with mocked media streams, deterministic synthetic motion, catalog gating, camera lifecycle/error coverage, and two-player isolated scoring. Verified npm run typecheck, lint, test (34 passing), build, and test:e2e (5 passing Chromium scenarios) on 2026-11-14. Browser tests are synthetic and do not claim physical webcam validation.

title: Extend viewport and calibrated camera regions to three and four players with independent scores
notes: Extended Bubble Battle to tested three- and four-player 2x2 layouts with independent targets/scores and existing calibrated camera-zone mapping. Kept a mirrored live-camera surface visible during gameplay, capped catch-up spawning after long frame gaps, and reduced React gameplay updates to about 30 FPS. Verified typecheck, lint, 37 unit/component tests, build, and 6 Playwright scenarios on 2026-11-15. Physical multi-person framing, webcam visibility/feel, and long-round hardware stability still require human validation.

notes: Attempt 1 matched only the composition and was rejected as too polished.
